title: The restriction of an integer multiplicity current to an open subdomain is integer multiplicity
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and V ⊆ U ⊆ ℝ^P with V open. Let T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) be integer multiplicity, i.e. T = τ(M, θ, ξ) for some IMRep R = (M, θ, ξ) of U (Simon 6.3.1). Then the restriction T⌞V ∈ 𝒟_n(V) is integer multiplicity in V. Here T⌞V = T.restrictDomain, T⌞V(ω) = T(ιω) with ι = testFormOnInclusion. Explicitly, T⌞V is represented by (M ∩ V, θ, ξ).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U V : Set (Euclid P)) (hVU : V ⊆ U) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen V → IsIntegerMultiplicity T → IsIntegerMultiplicity (T.restrictDomain hVU)
